summary: Iteration 59 — re-validation of the 4 blocking defects from iteration 58 + FIX #5/#6 + regression. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_solespay_fixes.py (27 cases) and re-ran the 5 previous SolesPay/activation suites: 96/97 pytest cases pass. FIX #1 (confirm-password JWT), FIX #2 (/payments/{ref}/status polling), FIX #3 (pending user redirected to /(app)/pay), FIX #5 (no duplicated SolesPay controls in PaymentGatewaysCard) and FIX #6 (pay-password testID unified) are ALL VERIFIED FIXED end-to-end in the browser: login as a pending user → /pay stepper (method → country → operator → phone+password) → POST /auth/confirm-password 200 → POST /payments/activate 200 {status: processing, gateway: soleaspay} → GET /payments/SPV-.../status 200 polled every 5 s, '⏳ Paiement en cours' + reference displayed. FIX #4 is only PARTIALLY fixed: the Ashtec branch of /payments/activate now really reaches ashtec_activation.create_ashtec_payment (no more `import ashtec` 503) and /payments/catalog merges Ashtec countries, and pick_gateway_for_country honours cfg['active'] — BUT the cascade still ignores each gateway's OWN country coverage, so with active='soleas' an Ashtec-only country (SN/ML/GA/NE/CD) advertised by the catalog is routed to SolesPay and dies with 400 'Opérateur invalide' instead of falling through to Ashtec. IMPORTANT ENV FINDING: Metro does NOT hot-reload edited files into the served web bundle in this preview — the stale bundle still contained router.replace('/(app)/activation'), which made FIX #3 look broken; `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required (twice, reproducible).

critical.issue: pick_gateway_for_country() only checks cfg['active'], {gw}_enabled and an explicit False in country_matrix — it never checks whether the gateway actually SUPPORTS the country. With active='soleas' (current state), country=SN returns 'soleas' (route-check confirms payin_gateway='soleas'), so activate for SN/ML/GA/NE/CD fails with 400 ('Opérateur invalide' / 'Opérateur non disponible ... chez SoleasPay') even though /payments/catalog advertises those countries via Ashtec. Fix: skip a gateway when country not in soleaspay.SUPPORTED (soleas) / ashtec_activation.COUNTRIES (ashtec) before returning it.

minor.issue: Pre-existing infra issue, not a code defect: the Ashtec API key is rejected (HTTP 401 unauthorized). With active='ashtec', /payments/activate SN returns 400 'Clé API introuvable ou révoquée. (unauthorized • HTTP 401 • Wave Money / SN)'. The routing/branch code is correct but a real Ashtec activation cannot complete until ASHTECPAY_API_KEY is valid.
Still read-modify-write of the whole payment_gateway doc (carried over from iter58); concurrent saves from the two admin cards can clobber each other.

action_items: Make pick_gateway_for_country() skip a gateway whose SUPPORTED/COUNTRIES map does not contain the country (SN/ML/GA/NE/CD must cascade to Ashtec even when active='soleas'). Today the catalog offers them and activate rejects them.
Restore a valid ASHTECPAY_API_KEY (env) — Ashtec /v1/collect answers 401 so the Ashtec leg can never complete a real activation.

Delete the leftover dead SolesPay handlers/state in PaymentGatewaysCard and decide whether the 'Soles Pay' enable/active block belongs there or only in SolesPaySettingsCard (add a cross-card refetch if it stays).
REMEMBER: after editing frontend files in this preview, run `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — Metro serves a stale web bundle otherwise (this is what made FIX #3 look unfixed).
critical_code_review_comments: pick_gateway_for_country() is the single routing decision point but has no notion of gateway coverage; /payments/catalog computes coverage independently. The two must share one helper or the catalog will keep advertising countries activate cannot serve.

ashtec_activation.create_ashtec_payment is called with operator=<display label> coming straight from the catalog; validate_country_operator() will 400 on any label mismatch — worth an explicit contract test once the API key works.

(admin)/index.tsx is still ~4050 lines and server.py ~4080 lines (>700-line guideline). SolesPaySettingsCard / PaymentGatewaysCard and the /payments/* + /admin/soleaspay/* routers should be extracted.

rca_of_the_issue: FIX #3 initially reproduced as FAILED (login → /activation). Root cause was NOT the code: the served expo-router web bundle still contained the pre-fix modules (grep of /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle showed router.replace('/(app)/activation') inside app/index.tsx and app/(app)/_layout.tsx while the source files had router.replace('/(app)/pay')). `supervisorctl restart frontend` rebuilt the bundle and the redirect worked immediately. The same stale-bundle behaviour was reproduced a second time when adding a testID. Remaining real defect: pick_gateway_for_country() returns the first ENABLED gateway whose country_matrix entry is not explicitly False, without checking that the gateway supports the country at all — so SN (Ashtec-only, advertised by /payments/catalog) is routed to SolesPay and activate returns 400 instead of cascading to Ashtec.
